Class Demand

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Demand
public final class Demand extends Object
Items the server wants right now, so other plugins can reward the work that brings them in (API version 17). A plugin with orders or requests tells Core what is wanted; any other plugin asks Core, so neither depends on the other. Tempest Contracts provides its open orders; Tempest Jobs pays more for work that brings in a wanted item. 
core.demandSource("contracts", () -> Set.of("Ore_Iron", "Wood_Oak_Trunk"));   // the provider
Demand.isWanted("Ore_Iron_Stone");                                           // true: a block of that ore
